data.title: 夜莺 · 窗外的鸟鸣
data.description: 窗外传来两声鸟鸣。她停下手里的书，侧耳听了一会儿，指给你看停在枝头的小鸟。
data.promptProse: Sitting serenely on a cushioned window seat in a quiet rehabilitation lounge, Nightingale tilts her head gently toward a small songbird perched outside on a blossoming plum branch. Translucent lace curtains filter soft morning sunlight, casting gentle light over her white dress, blonde hair, and Sarkaz horns.
data.animaCaption: Seated serenely on a cushioned window seat behind translucent lace curtains, she tilts her head gently to listen to a songbird perched outside on a blossoming branch. Soft morning sunlight washes quietly across the lounge.
